description: The managed backend of one builder app in plain words: draft (sign in methods, invite only, roles, tables with their fields and who may see, add, change and delete, file buckets, automations), pending = changes of the draft not live yet (destructive = true when they delete saved data), live (address, publishable app key, the start of the secret key, privacy page, usage against the caps: data, files, traffic this UTC month, rows per table; capReason when writes stop at a cap; boosted = double limits from an add-on; sign in client ids by platform), limits (live backends used and allowed, plan caps), addons (extra backends and double limit add-ons bought on the billing page, $10 a month each, Pro and Team; bought by the workspace owner in the dashboard, never through this tool), backups (daily, newest 7 kept, and before destructive changes) and storeAnswers (store privacy form answers). Free: no live backend, the preview uses sample data and the backend code can be downloaded. Read only. Every plan with an account.
